Webots web player (WebotsView), release R2025a
=============================================

These files are an unmodified copy of https://cyberbotics.com/wwi/R2025a/
(the player that Webots' HTML5 animation export loads), except that the few
absolute URLs that pointed back to cyberbotics.com now point into this folder,
so that the page loads nothing from a third-party server.  Made with
webots_demo/tools/export_web.py of the paper's code.
